components-actions-button.name: Button
components-actions-button.description:
Triggers an action or navigation. Use `default` for the single primary action on a view,
`outline` or `secondary` for supporting actions, `ghost` inside toolbars and dense lists,
`destructive` for irreversible actions, and `link` when the action should read as inline text.
Do not use a Button for page navigation when a plain link is enough.

Figma: Button (shadcn/ui kit). Figma `Variant` ↔ `variant`, `Size` ↔ `size`, `Icon` boolean ↔ child icon.

components-data-display-badge.name: Badge
components-data-display-badge.description:
Compact label for status, category or count, placed next to the thing it describes. Use `default`
for a single highlighted tag, `secondary` or `outline` for neutral metadata, `destructive` for errors
and blocked states, `ghost` inside dense tables, and `link` when the badge navigates (render with
`asChild` and an anchor). Do not use a Badge as a button; it has no pressed state.

Figma: Badge (shadcn/ui kit). Figma `Variant` ↔ `variant`; the `Icon` boolean ↔ a leading icon child.

components-layout-card.name: Card
components-layout-card.description:
Surface that groups related content and actions into a single unit. Compose it from `CardHeader`
(with `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, optional `CardAction`), `CardContent` and `CardFooter`; spacing
is shared through the `size` prop. Use cards for scannable collections (dashboards, lists of entities)
and settings sections. Do not nest cards or use a card as the only container on a page.

Figma: Card (shadcn/ui kit). Figma `Size` ↔ `size`; header / footer booleans ↔ presence of the sub-components.

components-forms-input.name: Input
components-forms-input.description:
Single-line text field. Accepts every native `<input>` attribute; type, placeholder and validation
state come from attributes, not variants (`aria-invalid` turns on the error styling). Always pair it
with a `Label` or an `aria-label`. Use a Textarea for multi-line text and a Select for closed choices.

Figma: Input (shadcn/ui kit). Figma `State` (Default / Focus / Error / Disabled) ↔ native state + `aria-invalid`.

components-forms-label.name: Label
components-forms-label.description:
Accessible caption for a form control, built on Radix Label. Associate it with `htmlFor` (or wrap the
control) so clicking the text focuses the field and screen readers announce it. It dims automatically
when a sibling `peer` control is disabled. Use it for every Input, Select, Checkbox and Switch; do not
use it for headings or helper text.

Figma: Label (shadcn/ui kit). Figma `Required` boolean ↔ a trailing marker child.
